job.title: Continuous Improvement Specialist
job.description:
Are you an experienced Continuous Improvement professional with a proven track record of delivering improvement projects within manufacturing?

Our client, a leading organisation within the food manufacturing industry, is seeking a Continuous Improvement Specialist to drive operational excellence across its manufacturing operations in Cork.

This is an excellent opportunity to take ownership of improvement projects, streamline processes, reduce waste and deliver measurable improvements in productivity, efficiency and cost performance.

What is on Offer?

  • Competitive salary
  • Company pension
  • Further education and professional development support
  • Paid maternity leave
  • Refer a Friend scheme
  • Long service awards

The Role:

  • Lead and deliver continuous improvement projects across manufacturing operations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve productivity, efficiency and reduce operational costs.
  • Implement Lean methodologies, including Lean Six Sigma, 5S, Kaizen and Value Stream Mapping.
  • Work closely with Operations, Engineering, Quality and Supply Chain teams to drive improvements.
  • Monitor KPIs, analyse performance data and measure project results.
  • Lead problem-solving workshops and support the implementation of process improvements.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement across the business.

What We Are Looking For:

  • Minimum 3 years' experience in a dedicated Continuous Improvement role.
  • Previous experience within a manufacturing environment is essential.
  • Proven experience leading and delivering CI projects is essential.
  • Strong knowledge of Lean Manufacturing methodologies and tools, including 5S, Kaizen and Root Cause Analysis.
  • Level 8 qualification in Engineering, Business, Industrial Management or a related discipline.
  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification would be advantageous.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence teams at all levels.

Interested?

If you have a strong background in Continuous Improvement and enjoy delivering measurable improvements within a manufacturing environment, we would love to hear from you.

Apply today to find out more about this opportunity!

job.title: Support Pharmacist
job.description:
Support Pharmacist - Clare

This role is full-time and flexible. It can be 5, 4 or 3 days a week. Excellent support.

To support the Managing Pharmacist in the running of the dispensary in busy and challenging environments. Working to agreed operating procedures within the pharmacy to maintain the highest ethical standards and deliver excellent customer care.

Duties and Responsibilities:­­­­ ­­­­­­­ ­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­ ­

  • To strictly observe the statutory regulations relating to the supply of medicinal products as per the Pharmacy Act 2007.
  • To adhere to dispensing standard operating procedures and ensure maintenance of the appropriate records and hygiene within the pharmacy as per the Pharmacy Act 2008.
  • To ensure that any issues of a Health and Safety nature are brought to the attention of the managing pharmacist.
  • To fulfil the required advisory role concerning over-the-counter medicines and ensure that staff on the medicine counter are aware of the procedure for counter-prescribing and its limitations.
  • Ensure that the proper procedure for the various Department of Health Schemes, e.g. DPS, LTI, GMS, is carried out and that they are kept up to date, submitted properly at the end of each month, and payment is reconciled as set down by Company Procedures.
  • Maintain appropriate stock levels in the Pharmacy, ensuring the correct storage and monitoring of dated products.
  • Assume full responsibility in the absence of the Pharmacist for supervising the pharmacy in the provision of medicinal products.
  • To ensure that the Pharmacy is kept clean and tidy and any Health and Safety issues are brought promptly to the attention of the Pharmacy Manager.
  • To ensure that the highest standards of care and service are delivered.
  • To understand, support and participate in the retail operation of the Pharmacy.
  • To participate in training and development programmes provided by the pharmacy.
  • To keep abreast of all changes to registration and PSI practice guidance.
  • Any other duties as required

Leadership & Teamwork

  • Support other stakeholders within the pharmacy and the company, ensuring the delivery of the company's goals.
  • This role requires a high level of proactivity and an ability to work on one's own initiative.
  • Build positive relationships with others in the pharmacy to create a positive working environment.
  • Participate in staff training programmes and implementation, and be proactive in developing the role function.
  • Give education & training programmes within the Pharmacy.
  • Assist the managing pharmacist with Health Promotion programmes and the implementation of Pharmaceutical Care.

job.title: Logistics Supervisor
job.description:
Job Title: Logistics Supervisor
Recruiter: FRS Recruitment
Company Overview
FRS Recruitment is hiring on behalf of a leading Irish agribusiness based in Dublin 22, Co. Dublin. Operating successfully for over 40 years, the company specialises in the bulk trading of whole grain cereals and non-grain feed ingredients (NGFIs). Supplying key players across the food, animal feed compounding, and brewing and distilling sectors, the business holds full accreditation with ISO 9001, EFISC-GTP, GAFTA, IGFA, CDP, and Sedex.
Role Overview
Reporting directly to the Senior Management Team (SMT), the Logistics Supervisor will play a pivotal role in managing and developing the company's logistics function. While primarily focused on transport and haulage operations, this role also involves close collaboration with and back-up support for the stock control function to ensure seamless end-to-end supply chain delivery.
Key Responsibilities
Transport & Haulage Management
  • Coordinate daily and weekly haulage bookings by liaising with intake operators to schedule deliveries and maximise stock location efficiency.
  • Negotiate competitive haulage rates on an ongoing basis while building strong relationships with third-party hauliers, suppliers, and customers.
  • Process bi-monthly haulage invoices and liaise directly with transport suppliers to resolve any billing queries or discrepancies.
  • Manage customer haulage recharges for ad-hoc transport arranged outside of existing contracts.
  • Provide regular, proactive updates to internal teams and external stakeholders regarding delivery schedules, delays, or operational changes.
Stock, Systems & Compliance
  • Stock Control Support: Assist in gathering and updating real-time stock data (drawings, balances, and movements) on internal systems, while resolving daily internal and external stock queries.
  • System & Process Improvement: Collaborate with the SMT, wider operational teams, and software developers to enhance logistics management systems and drive best-practice efficiencies.
  • Compliance & Risk: Monitor daily logistics activities to ensure full adherence to industry standards and proactively identify potential compliance risks.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with the trading, shipping/execution, quality, and finance teams to guarantee uninterrupted product availability for customers.
Ideal Candidate Profile
  • Experience: Previous experience in a logistics, transport, or supply chain role within an SME or larger organisation is a strong advantage.
  • Education: A relevant third-level qualification in logistics, supply chain, or business is desirable, though practical experience is equally valued.
  • Technical Skills: Strong numerical aptitude and high proficiency in MS Office (particularly Excel) and logistics/ERP systems.
  • Communication: Excellent interpersonal and negotiation skills, with the confidence to build rapport and resolve issues with hauliers, customers, and internal teams.
  • Work Ethic & Mindset: A proactive problem-solver with high attention to detail, capable of multitasking under tight deadlines while taking ownership of projects from start to finish.
  • Adaptability: A flexible, team-oriented approach paired with the initiative to work autonomously and drive continuous improvement.
Remuneration & Benefits Package
  • Salary: Competitive basic salary, commensurate with experience (DOE).
  • Bonus: Performance-related annual bonus (linked to company profit targets and individual performance)*.
  • Annual Leave: 23 days of annual leave.
  • Healthcare: Company-funded basic health insurance plan covering the employee and eligible dependents*.
  • Pension: Optional company pension scheme with employer-matched contributions up to 10% of annual salary* (subject to Auto-Enrolment regulations).
  • On-Site Perks: Access to a fully subsidised on-site canteen.
  • Professional Development: Full financial support for relevant training courses and professional examinations.
*Note: Eligibility for the bonus, healthcare, and matched pension benefits applies upon successful completion of a six-month probationary period (subject to statutory pension Auto-Enrolment rules).
N.B. candidates must be living and based in Ireland – no option for visa sponsorship with this role.

This opportunity would suit an Electrical Engineer with pharmaceutical experience or a strong Electrical Design Engineer with experience in a highly regulated environment.

The role

What you will bring

  • A Level 8 degree in Electrical Engineering.

  • Knowledge of electrical circuit sizing, load calculations and process instrumentation.

  • Pharmaceutical experience is preferred, although candidates from other highly regulated industries will also be considered.

Apply now or contact Kerry for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Employability Job Coach
job.description:
On behalf of our sister company, Turas Nua, I am recruiting for an Employability Job Coach to cover our Waterford office. Full Driving licence essential, access to / own car.

This is a part time role, 3 days per week.

PURPOSE OF ROLE

As the Employability Job Coach, your primary responsibility is to lead the delivery of the EmployAbility contract at a local level. As a Job Coach you will provide support, mentoring, and coaching to ensure our clients receive exceptional service.

ABOUT DEPARTMENT

EmployAbility assists individuals with disabilities in securing employment and provides ongoing support, including job coaching. Managed by Turas Nua, an Irish Cooperative social enterprise within the FRS Network, we have been serving rural communities since 1980.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Manage a caseload of 25 clients at any one time.
  • Undertake employment assessments and career planning with participants to assess their employment goals, skills, and establish individual employment plans.
  • Meet with clients regularly and as required to determine their employment aspirations, experiences, abilities, skills, and potential obstacles.
  • Establish a rapport with clients and develop positive working relationships, ensuring they are active participants in all phases of the job placement process.
  • Be proactive in working with employers to source and secure employment opportunities for participants.
  • Design proactive job development strategies as needed, to help participants secure employment opportunities.
  • Work with clients and employers to negotiate appropriate workplace adjustments.
  • Complete environmental analyses to assess whether workplaces will be supportive environments for clients who may need some level of ongoing support from their co-workers.
  • Arrange and attend job interviews for clients.
  • Act as an advocate for clients where necessary.
  • Provide in-person and/or phone support to employers, supervisors, and co-workers where necessary.
  • Respond immediately when issues arise concerning clients’ wellbeing.
  • Always maintain high professional standards and confidentiality.
  • Work autonomously and flexibly as required, which may include some work outside of normal office hours.
  • Maintain professional relationships with clients, staff, and employers, with particular attention to confidentiality and the maintenance of boundaries.
  • Record the progress of individuals using the organisation's reporting systems and keep accurate and complete records of casework with them.

ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Possess a relevant third-level qualification or qualify through experience.
  • Empathetic, professional, extroverted and enjoy working with people.
  • Understanding of local/ national services for people with disabilities.
  • Fluent in written and spoken English.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Hold a full clean driving licence, with access to a car being essential for this position.

Experience working with individuals with disabilities/illness/injury desirable

Recruiter: Amee Mullen

job.title: Agri Mill Operative
job.description:

Kinsale, Co. Cork

FRS Recruitment is hiring on behalf of a leading Irish agribusiness for a Mill Operator / Production Operator to join their busy feed mill operation in Kinsale. This position would suit someone with experience in production, manufacturing, agricultural processing, feed milling, or machinery operation who is mechanically minded and comfortable working with computerised production systems.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a well-established and successful business that offers long-term career stability, training, overtime opportunities, and performance-related bonuses.

The Role

Reporting to the Production Manager, the successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring the safe, efficient, and consistent operation of the feed mill. You will be involved throughout the production process, from raw material intake and processing through to the production of finished animal feed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Operate and monitor computerised production and process control systems.
  • Manage batching, mixing, pelleting, and heat treatment processes.
  • Monitor product quality, production targets, and plant performance.
  • Manage the movement and storage of raw materials and finished products.
  • Carry out routine plant inspections, cleaning, and basic maintenance activities.
  • Identify, troubleshoot, and report mechanical or production issues.
  • Maintain accurate production, quality, and cleaning records.
  • Adhere to all health & safety, feed safety, quality assurance, and traceability procedures.
  • Assist with manual handling and general production duties as required.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives within the mill operation.

Candidate Requirements

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Experience in feed milling, food production, agricultural processing, manufacturing, or a similar production environment.
  • Experience operating computerised production or process control systems.
  • Good mechanical aptitude with the ability to perform basic maintenance tasks.
  • Strong awareness of health and safety procedures.
  • Good attention to detail and record-keeping skills.
  • The ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
  • Flexibility to work additional hours during peak seasonal periods.
  • Forklift or loader experience would be advantageous but is not essential.

What's on Offer?

  • Permanent, full-time position.
  • Guaranteed minimum of 40 hours per week.
  • Day shifts only with no night work required.
  • Typical start times of 6:00am or 7:00am, depending on seasonal production requirements.
  • Overtime opportunities available during busy periods and paid at time and a half.
  • Weekly performance-related bonus linked to production targets and KPIs.
  • Competitive hourly rate, dependent on experience and suitability.
  • Full training provided on site-specific equipment, plant, and systems.
  • Opportunity to build a long-term career within a growing and well-established Irish agribusiness.

Apply

If you have experience in production, manufacturing, agricultural operations, feed milling, or machinery operation and are looking for a secure, hands-on role with excellent long-term prospects, we would love to hear from you.

  • To minimise the level of unplanned stoppages of machinery and reduce production losses due to machinery or equipment downtime.

job.title: Quality Manager
job.description:
Are you an experienced Quality or Technical professional within food manufacturing looking to take the next step into a senior leadership role?

Our client, an established food production company in West Cork, is seeking an Assistant Quality Manager to support and oversee the site Quality function.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Quality professional to take on greater responsibility, supporting the Quality Manager in leading the team, maintaining high food safety standards and driving continuous improvement across the business.

You will play a key role in the day to day management of the Quality function, with responsibility for overseeing operations and leading the team in the absence of the Quality Manager.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the management and coordination of the site Quality team and daily activities.

  • Lead and coordinate internal, customer, third-party and regulatory audits.

  • Liaise with customers and suppliers on quality matters, specifications and documentation.
  • Oversee production record reviews, calibration requirements and quality documentation.
  • Support food safety and quality training across the site.
  • Monitor quality performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

What We Are Looking For

  • A qualification in Food Science, Food Technology, Quality Management or a related discipline.
  • Previous Quality, QA, Technical or Food Safety experience within a food manufacturing environment.
  • Strong knowledge of HACCP, food safety legislation and Quality Management Systems.
  • Experience managing or participating in internal, customer and external audits.
  • Previous experience supervising, mentoring or leading a Quality or Technical team.
  • Strong communication, organisational and problem-solving skills.
  • The confidence and ability to take ownership of the Quality function when required.

What Is on Offer?

  • Attractive salary package.
  • Senior-level Quality role with genuine leadership responsibility.
  • Opportunity to support and develop an established Quality team.
  • Broad involvement across food safety, HACCP, audits and regulatory compliance.
  • Opportunity to develop management experience and progress towards a Quality Manager position.
  • Long-term career opportunity within an established food production business in West Cork.

Apply Today

If you are an experienced Quality or Technical professional within food manufacturing and are ready to take the next step in your career, this could be an excellent opportunity.

Apply today with your CV to find out more about this Assistant Quality Manager position in West Cork.

job.title: Employability Job Coach
job.description:
On behalf of our sister company, Turas Nua, I am recruiting for an Employability Job Coach to cover our Kildare offices, based in Newbridge. Full Driving licence essential, access to / own car.

PURPOSE OF ROLE

As the Employability Job Coach, your primary responsibility is to lead the delivery of the EmployAbility contract at a local level. As a Job Coach you will provide support, mentoring, and coaching to ensure our clients receive exceptional service.

ABOUT DEPARTMENT

EmployAbility assists individuals with disabilities in securing employment and provides ongoing support, including job coaching. Managed by Turas Nua, an Irish Cooperative social enterprise within the FRS Network, we have been serving rural communities since 1980.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Manage a caseload of 25 clients at any one time.
  • Undertake employment assessments and career planning with participants to assess their employment goals, skills, and establish individual employment plans.
  • Meet with clients regularly and as required to determine their employment aspirations, experiences, abilities, skills, and potential obstacles.
  • Establish a rapport with clients and develop positive working relationships, ensuring they are active participants in all phases of the job placement process.
  • Be proactive in working with employers to source and secure employment opportunities for participants.
  • Design proactive job development strategies as needed, to help participants secure employment opportunities.
  • Work with clients and employers to negotiate appropriate workplace adjustments.
  • Complete environmental analyses to assess whether workplaces will be supportive environments for clients who may need some level of ongoing support from their co-workers.
  • Arrange and attend job interviews for clients.
  • Act as an advocate for clients where necessary.
  • Provide in-person and/or phone support to employers, supervisors, and co-workers where necessary.
  • Respond immediately when issues arise concerning clients’ wellbeing.
  • Always maintain high professional standards and confidentiality.
  • Work autonomously and flexibly as required, which may include some work outside of normal office hours.
  • Maintain professional relationships with clients, staff, and employers, with particular attention to confidentiality and the maintenance of boundaries.
  • Record the progress of individuals using the organisation's reporting systems and keep accurate and complete records of casework with them.

ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Possess a relevant third-level qualification or qualify through experience.
  • Empathetic, professional, extroverted and enjoy working with people.
  • Understanding of local/ national services for people with disabilities.
  • Fluent in written and spoken English.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Hold a full clean driving licence, with access to a car being essential for this position.

Experience working with individuals with disabilities/illness/injury desirable

Recruiter: Amee Mullen

job.title: QC Validation Specialist
job.description:
Seeking a QC Validation Specialist !

This position plays a critical role in ensuring analytical methods are properly designed, validated and transferred in alignment with EU/FDA GMP requirements for advanced therapy products.

We are particularly interested in speaking with candidates who have hands-on experience designing validation studies, as well as authoring and reviewing validation protocols and reports—not just executing test methods developed by others. A genuine understanding of the regulatory landscape and the rationale behind validation activities is essential.

The Role

In this position, you will:

  • Lead and support the development, validation and technology transfer of new and established analytical methods for gene therapy products.

  • Design validation studies and generate validation protocols, data analysis summaries and comprehensive reports.

  • Ensure analytical methods are fully validated and transferred into QC GMP laboratories in line with regulatory expectations (EU/FDA, ICH Q2(R1), GMP, data integrity).

  • Create, update and maintain method SOPs and technical documentation.

  • Provide clear communication and progress updates to cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Conduct routine assessments of analytical methods to ensure continued control and suitability.

  • Support Quality Management System activities, including document control and data integrity oversight.

  • Maintain and track personal training, GMP compliance and document lifecycle responsibilities (deviations, CAPAs, change controls).

  • When required, perform analytical testing of gene therapy products according to approved specifications.

Candidate Profile

  • A degree or Master’s in a scientific discipline (e.g., Biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry).

  • Approx. 2+ years’ experience in the pharmaceutical, biologics, or a similarly regulated environment.

  • Demonstrated experience in method validation, including:

    • Designing validation studies,

    • Writing and reviewing protocols and validation reports,

    • A strong understanding of regulatory requirements and data integrity.

  • Experience with analytical techniques (advantageous but not essential): qPCR, HPLC (RP-HPLC/SEC), ELISA, SDS-PAGE/Western blot, cell culture, DNA extraction.

  • Strong understanding of ICH Q2(R1).

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Keywords: QC Validation Chemist, Method Transfer Chemist, Analytical Chemist, Scientist, Chemist, Analytical Chemist, Scientist,Chemist, HPLC,GMP

job.title: Case Worker

Caseworker required to work in our Tullamore Office.

This role will be working 3 days in the Tullamore office and 2 days in the Portarlington office. Own car and full clean licence is essential for this role

Monday-Friday 09:00-05:00(on-site)
We are looking for candidates with strong customer service and administration experience.


ABOUT TURAS NUA
IPNES supports people who are over 12 months unemployed or employed part-time on low earnings, by providing intensive, targeted and personalised employment support services. The IPNES contract is delivered by Turas Nua, the Irish employability services provider. Turas Nua is wholly owned by FRS Network, an Irish cooperative social enterprise, which has been delivering services to Irish communities since 1980.


PURPOSE OF ROLE
As a caseworker, you will work with clients referred by the Department of Social Protection to IPNES. You will manage a caseload of clients, coordinating our internal support specialists and external organisations to provide a personalised, planned support service to each client, to help them gain sustainable employment. You will also provide each client with one-to-one advice and support to guide their progress towards employment.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop and manage a robust case management plan for each client, working towards sustainable, full-time employment.
  • use our industry-leading assessment technology to identify the client’s goals, ambitions, and barriers to employment. Use the output from the assessment to inform a structured personal progression plan, agreed with the client.
  • Recognise hidden motivations and conflict when assessing clients’ job-readiness, in order to address these with appropriate support and interventions.
  • Provide coaching and mentoring to clients, including providing intensive job search support when the client is job ready.
  • Identify, structure, and recommend training solutions in consultation with in-house tutors, to meet the specific learning and training needs of clients.
  • Fast-track job-ready clients for immediate job interviews brokered by our Employer Services consultants.
  • Maintain strong knowledge of the local labour market.
  • Organise a daily schedule that includes face-to-face meetings, phone calls, online meetings, and email correspondence with clients and other service providers.
  • Work closely with local and national specialist services (e.g., training, literacy, housing, health) to assist the client in their journey towards employment.
  • Present and facilitate workshops and group-learning presentations to clients weekly.
  • Achieve daily and monthly contractual key performance indicator (KPI) targets, managing a caseload of clients; for example, time-bound contacts, assessments, and support activities.
  • Provide guidance and support for more job-ready clients during their initial weeks of employment, helping them to successfully transition to sustainable employment.
  • Ensure that client interactions are recorded accurately on the CRM system.
  • Ensure data protection regulations are fully adhered to.


ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Leaving Certificate or equivalent.
  • Minimum of three years’ experience of working in a customer focused, target driven environment.
  • Strong IT skills/experience in the use of Microsoft office and CRM systems. Must be comfortable with all aspects of remote working technology.
  • Excellent administrative skills – fast & accurate data entry skills.
  • The ability to build rapport and work effectively with a diverse range of individuals both in person and over the phone.
  • Experience in delivering presentations in a group setting or public speaking.
  • Strong prioritisation and time management skills.
  • Fluent written and spoken English.

job.title: Farm Mechanic Manager - Saudi Arabia
job.description:
FRS Recruitment are currently recruiting for a Farm Maintenance Manager (Machinery) for a large farm operation in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time permanent role.

Remuneration package

  • 97 days annual leave a year.
  • 6 free flights per year to and from Saudi Arabia
  • Accommodation Provided
  • Tax Free Salaries and Bonus
  • Vehicle
  • VIP Medical Cover

You will have responsibility and autonomy for scheduling maintenance for multiple Dairy farms. Our client is one of the largest vertically integrated dairy companies in the Middle East, managing over 195,000 dairy cows across seven modern dairy farms.

The FMM will work closely with farm workshop staff and demonstrate areas of improvement that can reduce costs / improve performance and reduce downtime on equipment. This will be a hands-on role where you will work with a multicultural workforce with a varying degree of ability.

The FMM will work side by side with the workshop team and transfer knowledge to them and help to improve their skills & ensure that the farm staff always keep updated service records.

Please note the ideal candidate for this role will be proficient in reading electrical and hydraulic drawings as you will be the contact for all mechanics when a breakdown arises.

Job overview

To plan and organize assigned farm mechanical maintenance staff so that the broad range of agricultural, industrial and animal feeding machinery and equipment is serviced, maintained and operated in accordance with company procedure. Train staff to ensure that competent and sufficient numbers of maintenance staff are available for the assigned farm sites.

Duties to include

  • To ensure that all maintenance staff are organised, trained and carry out all maintenance in accordance with all company Maintenance and Safety procedures for all farm agricultural, industrial and feeding machinery and equipment.
  • To ensure that all maintenance tasks are carried out in a safe manner and in accordance with company policy and standards.
  • To ensure all workshop buildings and surrounding areas, tools, lifting equipment and electrical equipment are in a clean and safe working condition.
  • To minimise the level of unplanned stoppages of machinery and reduce production losses due to machinery or equipment downtime.
  • To oversee routine and preventative maintenance of all agricultural, industrial and feeding machinery and equipment within the Division.
  • To monitor and assess the performance of all maintenance staff in conjunction with the Farming and Maintenance Manager and recommend training as require.
  • Liaise with suppliers to arrange warranty repairs.
  • Report issues that affect the reliability and running costs of equipment.
  • Arrange OEM training and access to required manuals for workshop staff.
  • Update company manuals that are used for maintaining and servicing machinery. Ensure that workshop staff are always following company manuals for servicing.
  • Identify parts that should be kept in the workshop central store that are necessary to keep equipment running. Ensure that the workshop store does not carry obsolete stock.
  • Navigate different manufacturers parts manuals / systems.
  • Arrange quotations from suppliers for the repair of equipment.

Core competencies

  • Excellent communicator with good influencing and person management skills.
  • A sound knowledge of troubleshooting and diagnostic fault finding.
  • A sound experience with all types of agricultural and mechanical machinery.
  • High degree of confidence and or decision-making capability.
  • Focused under pressure, self-motivated, assertive, confident, fair, and open-minded.
  • Strong IT skills

Candidate profile

  • 5 years year’s + experience in a workshop or service centre environment
  • Experience in managing a large-scale maintenance.
  • Experience with maintenance of large scale agricultural and industrial equipment, and petrol and diesel engine Vehicles
  • Fully operational in the use of structured maintenance systems with a particular emphasis on a planned approach to preventive maintenance and recording and analysing data

To apply

Please email your cv through the attached link

job.title: Agri Plant Team Lead
job.description:
Agri Plant Team Lead

Location: Goresbridge, Co. Kilkenny
Job Type: Full-Time

About the Opportunity

FRS Recruitment is hiring on behalf of a leading Irish agribusiness for an Agri Plant Team Lead to join their operation in Goresbridge, Co. Kilkenny.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced operator, production professional, or agricultural team member looking to take the next step into a leadership position. The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting plant operations, leading a small team, and ensuring high standards of safety, quality, and efficiency.

The Role

As Agri Plant Team Lead, you will oversee day-to-day plant activities, coordinate production operations, and provide leadership and support to the wider team. This is a hands-on position suited to someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced agricultural or production environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coordinate, and support the plant team on a daily basis.
  • Allocate workloads and prioritise tasks to meet production targets.
  • Provide training, coaching, and guidance to team members.
  • Operate and oversee processing equipment and plant machinery.
  • Monitor product quality and ensure operational standards are maintained.
  • Support stock management, storage operations, and materials handling.
  • Operate forklifts and loading equipment where required.
  • Maintain accurate production and maintenance records.
  • Ensure compliance with all health, safety, quality, and regulatory requirements.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives across the operation.

Who Should Apply?

This role would suit candidates from a variety of agricultural and production backgrounds, including:

  • Feed Mill Operators
  • Grain Store Operators
  • Seed Plant Operatives
  • Agri Production Operatives
  • Mill Operators
  • Agricultural Contractors
  • Co-op and Agri Merchant Employees
  • Food Production Operators
  • Manufacturing Operatives
  • Warehouse or Plant Operatives looking to progress into a leadership role

We welcome applications from individuals who have strong operational experience and are looking to take the next step in their career, even if they have not previously held a formal supervisory position.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Experience within an agricultural, grain, feed, seed, production, or manufacturing environment.
  • Strong mechanical aptitude and problem-solving ability.
  • Good organisational and communication skills.
  • A positive, hands-on approach to leadership.
  • A strong commitment to safety, quality, and operational excellence.
  • The ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

What's on Offer

job.title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
job.description:
Strategic Customer Success Manager

Location: Dublin | B2B SaaS |

I'm currently recruiting for a growing Dublin-based SaaS business looking to hire an experienced Strategic Customer Success Manager.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing technology business specialising in brand protection, helping leading global brands identify grey-market activity, unauthorised sellers and counterfeit products across online marketplaces.

The successful candidate will take ownership of approximately 20 strategic customer accounts, ensuring successful onboarding, strong product adoption, measurable customer value and long-term retention.

This is more than a traditional Customer Success role. You'll also have the opportunity to help shape and build the Customer Success function, developing processes, playbooks and strategies as the business continues to grow.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of approximately 20 strategic and enterprise accounts.

  • Lead customer onboarding and ensure a smooth implementation process.

  • Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders across eCommerce, legal, IP and brand protection teams.

  • Drive product adoption and ensure customers are achieving measurable value.

  • Monitor customer satisfaction, account health and retention risks.

  • Identify opportunities for account growth and work closely with Account Management.

  • Support renewals by demonstrating the value delivered to customers.

  • Work closely with Product and Engineering teams, sharing customer feedback and influencing product improvements.

  • Help build and develop Customer Success processes, playbooks and best practices.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years' experience in Customer Success within a B2B SaaS environment.

  • Proven experience managing strategic or enterprise-level accounts.

  • Strong onboarding, implementation and customer adoption experience.

  • Experience building and improving Customer Success processes or playbooks.

  • Confident managing senior stakeholders and complex customer relationships.

  • Strong commercial awareness, with an understanding of retention, renewals and account growth.

  • Analytical and structured approach to customer reporting and performance.

  • Comfortable working independently in a growing business where processes are still being developed.

Desirable Experience

  • Background in eCommerce, online marketplaces, brand protection, IP or legal technology.

  • Experience using customer usage data and analytics to drive account strategy.

The Opportunity

  • Join a growing Dublin-based technology business.

  • Take ownership of a portfolio of high-value strategic accounts.

  • Play a key role in shaping and developing the Customer Success function.

  • Work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams.

  • Opportunity to make a real impact within a growing SaaS environment.

If you're an experienced Customer Success professional looking for a strategic role where you can make an impact and help build a function, I'd love to hear from you.

Please feel free to message me directly or send your CV for a confidential discussion.

job.title: CNM2- Nurse Educator
job.description:
Nurse Tutor / Nurse Educator


Contract Type: Permanent, Full-Time
Working Hours: 78 hours per fortnight
Reporting To: Director of Nursing, with accountability to the Assistant Director of Nursing

Purpose of the Role

The successful candidate will play a key role in the planning, development, coordination, delivery and evaluation of evidence-based, quality-assured education and training programmes.

Quality, patient safety and person-centred care will remain central to the design, delivery and evaluation of all educational programmes.

Key Responsibilities

Teaching and Learning

  • Identify and assess learning and development needs among registered nurses and Healthcare Assistants within the Approved Centre.

  • Design, develop, coordinate and deliver educational programmes that maintain the professional integrity of each division of the NMBI nursing register.

  • Develop and deliver appropriate education and training programmes for healthcare support staff.

  • Identify, source and evaluate internal and external education providers to support programme delivery.

  • Lead curriculum development and prepare educational programmes for Category 1 approval in accordance with the relevant Nursing and Midwifery Board of Ireland (NMBI) policies.

  • Coordinate programme administration, including bookings, scheduling, timetabling and cancellations, in line with organisational policies and procedures.

  • Contribute to the development and delivery of programmes leading to academic awards, ensuring compliance with the standards and requirements of relevant regulatory and academic awarding bodies.

  • Regularly review programme content, educational materials and teaching methodologies to ensure they remain current, relevant and evidence-based.

  • Drive continuous quality improvement through programme evaluation, review, improvement planning and the monitoring of corrective actions.

  • Use relevant data to assess and measure the effectiveness of education and training initiatives.

  • Participate in peer reviews and audits of educational programmes and related services in accordance with approved quality assurance procedures.

  • Assess the impact of educational programmes on service delivery and the professional practices of nursing and healthcare support staff.

  • Identify and coordinate the procurement of equipment and educational resources required for programme delivery, ensuring compliance with financial regulations.

  • Develop and deliver face-to-face, online and blended learning programmes that address identified educational and professional development needs.

  • Evaluate and audit the effectiveness of education and training programmes, preparing reports and recommendations for the Director of Nursing.

  • Provide visible, practice-based support, supervision and education within clinical settings to facilitate the application of classroom learning to clinical practice.

  • Promote nursing care that is consistent with current evidence, organisational policies and established educational standards.

Leadership and Management

  • Establish and maintain effective working relationships with nurse managers, nursing and healthcare staff, multidisciplinary colleagues, senior management and other relevant stakeholders.

  • Collaborate with national Centres for Nurse Education and Centres of Nursing and Midwifery Education, the NMBI, Quality and Qualifications Ireland (QQI), external examiners, third-level institutions and other relevant stakeholders.

  • Promote a safe working environment through appropriate risk assessments, the identification of hazards and the implementation of suitable control measures.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of educational programmes and related activities in accordance with organisational policies, programme approval requirements and data protection legislation.

  • Maintain relevant statistical and operational data and prepare quarterly and annual reports for the Director of Nursing.

  • Ensure the effective and responsible use of resources, in accordance with organisational financial regulations.

  • Attend meetings, seminars and participate in committees and working groups as delegated by the Director of Nursing.

  • Promote collaborative, team-based approaches to nursing care in partnership with Clinical Nurse Managers and senior nursing management.

  • Lead the development, review and updating of policies, procedures and guidelines relevant to the Nurse Education function.

  • Plan and prioritise workloads effectively, ensuring responsibilities are completed within agreed timeframes.

  • Contribute to the ongoing development of Nurse Education in alignment with the organisation’s strategic objectives and vision.

Professional Responsibilities

  • Remain informed of developments within the nursing profession, nurse education and the wider healthcare sector.

  • Ensure that all educational programmes incorporate quality, patient safety and person-centred care principles.

  • Maintain an up-to-date understanding of relevant legislation, policies, procedures, regulatory requirements, professional standards and quality assurance frameworks.

  • Protect the confidentiality of learner records, particularly personal information and assessment or competency results, in accordance with data protection legislation.

  • Promote research-informed and evidence-based practice throughout all education and training programmes.

  • Apply a continuous quality enhancement approach to the development and delivery of educational programmes.

  • Take responsibility for personal professional development, reflective practice and ongoing performance improvement.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Maintain a working knowledge of the Mental Health Commission, the Judgement Support Framework and other relevant standards and regulatory requirements.

  • Ensure compliance with applicable requirements, including DGSA, Health and Safety Authority (HSA) standards, National Standards for the Prevention and Control of Healthcare-Associated Infections, hygiene standards and relevant HSE protocols.

Essential Requirements

The successful candidate must meet the following criteria:

  • Be registered in the General Division of the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Ireland register.

  • Be registered, or eligible for registration, as a Nurse Tutor with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Ireland.

  • Have a minimum of three years’ post-registration clinical experience.

  • A dual qualification in General and Psychiatric Nursing is desirable.

Professional Knowledge and Expertise

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

  • An understanding of emerging developments within nursing and the wider healthcare sector.

  • Knowledge of the organisation and management of continuing education and professional development in nursing.

  • An understanding of curriculum design, development and the NMBI programme approval process.

  • The ability to apply educational theory to teaching, facilitation, assessment and learner support.

  • Knowledge of relevant legislation, professional regulatory requirements and the standards of academic awarding bodies.

Interpersonal and Communication Skills

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to communicate information clearly, confidently and persuasively.

  • The ability to establish and maintain effective professional relationships.

  • The ability to provide constructive feedback that supports and encourages learning.

  • Strong IT literacy, including proficiency in email, PowerPoint, Excel, databases, search engines and other relevant applications.

Planning and Organisational Skills

  • Excellent organisational and time management skills, with the ability to achieve objectives within agreed deadlines.

  • Effective planning and coordination skills, including resource management, scheduling and activity coordination.

  • The ability to manage competing priorities, respond to unexpected situations and maintain an effective workload.

  • The ability to manage budgets and ensure the efficient utilisation of resources.

Commitment to Quality Service Delivery

  • The ability to maintain a professional and disciplined approach under pressure, demonstrating resilience, flexibility and persistence.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate information and make informed decisions efficiently.

  • A commitment to self-assessment, reflective practice and continuous professional improvement.

  • A strong commitment to delivering high-quality, person-centred care and education.

Leadership and Teamwork

  • Demonstrate motivation, initiative and an innovative approach within a changing healthcare environment.

  • Contribute positively to team development and collaborative working practices.

  • Work effectively and cooperatively with multidisciplinary teams and other professional groups.

  • Demonstrate the ability to lead projects and take initiative in developing new initiatives.

  • Possess effective meeting management and chairing skills.

To know more contact Sonal Tikariha

job.title: Mechanical Inspection Engineer
job.description:
Mechanical Inspection Engineer

Location: Dublin, Meath or Louth
Salary: From €61,800

The Opportunity

An excellent opportunity has arisen for an experienced engineering professional to join a leading engineering inspection and examination provider.

The role involves carrying out inspections, examinations and reporting on a wide range of pressure equipment, helping customers maintain statutory compliance while supporting the safety of people, property and equipment.

You will work with customers across a variety of sectors, including local authorities, emergency services, education, dairy processing, pharmaceutical, brewing and general industry.

We are ideally looking for someone based in Dublin, Meath or Louth, although candidates in other Leinster locations may also be considered, as the workload is primarily focused across the province.

What Will You Be Doing?

As a Pressure Engineer Surveyor, you will be responsible for inspecting, testing and reporting on a variety of pressure equipment, ranging from air-conditioning units and coffee boilers to pressure vessels, safety valves and steam boilers.

Your role will be focused on delivering a high-quality inspection service, identifying potential safety issues and helping customers ensure their equipment meets the required standards and regulations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Carry out rigorous inspections and examinations of pressure equipment to identify defects and potential safety issues.
  • Inspect equipment including boilers, pressure vessels, heating systems, air-conditioning equipment, refrigeration systems and associated pressure equipment.
  • Complete detailed and accurate technical reports following inspections.
  • Identify and clearly communicate defects, safety concerns and required actions to customers.
  • Help customers maintain compliance with relevant statutory and industry requirements.
  • Manage an assigned workload and inspection schedule across your geographical area.
  • Deliver a professional and responsive service to customers.
  • Maintain accurate records of inspections and examinations.
  • Work independently while having access to technical support when required.
  • Represent the organisation professionally when working at customer sites.

What We Are Looking For

To be considered for this opportunity, you should have:

  • An NVQ Level 4 engineering qualification, or equivalent qualification at the higher end of NFQ Level 6.
  • Substantial practical, hands-on engineering experience working with equipment such as boilers, pressure vessels, heating systems, air-conditioning units and/or refrigeration systems.
  • The ability to understand and assess technical engineering equipment and identify potential defects or safety concerns.
  • The ability to explain complex technical matters clearly and communicate safety issues to customers in a timely, professional and confident manner.
  • Strong written English and the ability to produce accurate, coherent and professional technical reports.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Office applications.
  • Confidence using modern IT devices such as tablets and smartphones.
  • A full clean driving licence.

The Person

This role would suit an experienced, practical engineer who enjoys combining technical engineering knowledge with independent field-based work and customer interaction.

You will need to be comfortable taking responsibility for your own workload, making sound technical assessments and communicating your findings clearly to customers.

Previous experience as an Engineer Surveyor would be highly beneficial, but candidates from hands-on maintenance, mechanical, pressure systems, boiler, HVAC or related engineering backgrounds who meet the technical requirements may also be well suited to the opportunity.

Successful candidates will be required to complete relevant background checks as part of the recruitment process.

Apply today, by sending your cv and I will contact you for a discussion.

Contact Eimar Galvin on 086 185 2313 or email egalvin@frsrecruitment for a confidential chat

job.title: QC Stability Manager
job.description:
QC Stability Manager

Location: Limerick/Clare
Industry: Pharmaceutical / Biotechnology

The Opportunity

Seeking an experienced QC Stability Manager to lead and oversee the stability programme within a pharmaceutical/biotechnology environment in Ireland.

This is an important leadership position, with responsibility for the successful delivery and ongoing management of stability studies for clinical and commercial products.The successful candidate will provide scientific and technical leadership across all aspects of the stability programme, including study design, protocol development, analytical data monitoring, statistical trending, reporting and regulatory compliance.

Working closely with Quality Control, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs and other key stakeholders, you will support operational excellence, continuous improvement and a strong GMP culture, ensuring that stability activities consistently meet applicable regulatory requirements and business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, coordination and execution of stability studies for clinical and commercial products, ensuring compliance with relevant regulatory guidelines and internal procedures.
  • Develop, maintain and review stability protocols, reports, SOPs, technical memoranda, specifications and regulatory documentation.
  • Generate and review stability reports, applying analytical expertise and statistical tools, including JMP, to interpret data and support shelf-life and expiry dating proposals.
  • Monitor stability data, identify trends, assess potential degradation pathways and provide scientific recommendations to support product quality and lifecycle management.
  • Ensure the stability programme remains aligned with FDA, EU, ICH and other applicable international regulatory requirements.
  • Manage stability-related Quality Management System activities, including deviations, change controls, CAPAs and investigations, ensuring timely and compliant closure.
  • Support the ongoing development, functionality and maintenance of stability-related processes and systems.
  • Identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance the effectiveness, efficiency and compliance of the stability programme.
  • Establish and monitor key performance indicators to support programme performance and continuous improvement.
  • Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to promote quality, GMP compliance and shared accountability.
  • Ensure adherence to GMP, Data Integrity and Good Documentation Practice (GDP) requirements.
  • Support team training and development, ensuring personnel are appropriately trained and qualified before undertaking GMP activities.
  • Ensure GMP documentation and quality records are completed accurately, maintained to a right-first-time standard and closed within agreed timelines.

The Ideal Candidate

  • A minimum of 5 years' relevant experience within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
  • Strong knowledge of stability principles relating to biologics and pharmaceutical products, including degradation pathways, accelerated stability studies and shelf-life determination.
  • Demonstrable expertise in analytical methodologies used in stability testing and the assessment of biologics.
  • A strong understanding of FDA, EU and ICH regulatory guidelines, as well as relevant pharmacopeial requirements.
  • Practical experience in stability data trending, statistical analysis and rate analysis to support retest period and shelf-life proposals.
  • Experience using statistical software, particularly JMP, for stability data analysis and interpretation.
  • A strong understanding of analytical method qualification and validation requirements for biologics and pharmaceutical products.
  • Excellent attention to detail, with a strong commitment to accurate record keeping and high-quality GMP documentation.
  • Good knowledge of pharmaceutical product development and associated development strategies.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

The Opportunity

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced stability professional to take ownership of an important function within an established pharmaceutical/biotechnology environment.

You will have the opportunity to contribute to stability strategy, drive technical and operational improvements, support team development and play an important role in maintaining the quality and lifecycle management of pharmaceutical products.

If you have a strong background in pharmaceutical or biologics stability and are looking for your next career opportunity, we would welcome your application

job.title: Automation Engineer
job.description:
Automation Engineer

Location: Dunboyne, Co: Meath

Candidate:

This role is suited to an Electrical, Automation, Control or Instrumentation Engineer with practical experience supporting the delivery, testing and commissioning of automation systems, ideally within water, wastewater or similar process environments.

The successful candidate should have hands-on experience in the configuration, programming, testing or commissioning of PLC-based control systems. Experience supporting automation upgrades involving PLCs, SCADA/HMI systems, instrumentation, industrial networks, remote I/O or third-party equipment is required.

Overview of Role:

The role is predominantly office-based, with site attendance required during surveys, testing, cutover and commissioning. The Automation Engineer will support and deliver assigned elements of PLC-based control-system projects within operational water and wastewater treatment facilities, including brownfield upgrades and PLC replacement projects.

The role covers PLC and SCADA/HMI development, system configuration and integration, documentation, FAT, SAT, commissioning and operational support. The engineer may work with Ignition and other SCADA/HMI platforms as part of wider automation project delivery.

The engineer will work under the direction of the Automation Team Lead and collaborate with senior engineers, Project Managers, client engineers, site operators and other engineering disciplines throughout the project lifecycle.

Responsibilities:

  • Configure, program, test and commission PLC-based control systems in accordance with approved designs and standards.
  • Assist with PLC replacement and migration activities, including preparation for phased cutover and rollback arrangements at operational facilities.
  • Develop and integrate PLC, HMI and SCADA applications, including communications with telemetry, instrumentation, MCCs, remote I/O and third-party equipment.
  • Prepare and update functional descriptions, software design documentation, I/O schedules, system architecture drawings and test documentation.
  • Participate in FAT, SAT, commissioning, troubleshooting and operational handover activities.
  • Work collaboratively with the Automation Team Lead, senior engineers, Project Managers and assigned SCADA/Automation Engineers to deliver project requirements.
  • Support liaison with client IT/OT teams regarding industrial networks, system security and secure remote access.
  • Maintain project software, configuration records, version history, licences and associated engineering documentation.
  • Provide input to project work breakdown structures, estimates and delivery plans in conjunction with the Automation Team Lead and Project Manager.
  • Follow and contribute to reusable software libraries, engineering standards and standardised solutions.
  • Support presales activities, site surveys, project scoping, estimating and solution development for new automation systems and system upgrades.
  • Survey, assess and document existing PLC, SCADA/HMI, instrumentation, industrial-network and control-system arrangements.

Essential Experience and Technical Skills

  • Practical experience contributing to PLC, automation or SCADA projects, preferably in water, wastewater or a similar process industry.
  • Experience configuring, modifying, testing or commissioning PLC-based control systems.
  • A working understanding of water or wastewater treatment processes, control philosophies, instrumentation, sequencing and interlocks.
  • A working understanding of SCADA system architecture and key components.
  • Experience with a SCADA/HMI platform such as Ignition, Iconics, Wonderware or equivalent.
  • Familiarity with industrial communication protocols used in SCADA and automation systems, such as Modbus TCP/RTU, OPC UA/DA or DNP3.
  • Two to five years’ relevant experience delivering or supporting PLC, automation or SCADA solutions.
  • Hands-on experience in PLC software development using Schneider or a comparable industrial PLC platform.
  • Basic knowledge of Ethernet, TCP/IP and other protocols used in industrial environments.
  • Awareness of cybersecurity good practice for SCADA and industrial control systems.
  • Experience configuring or maintaining alarms within a SCADA system.
  • Full driving licence.

Desirable Experience and Technical Skills

  • Ignition certification or substantial Ignition experience.
  • Experience with Schneider Modicon PLCs and Control Expert/Unity Pro.
  • Experience with Siemens or Rockwell PLC platforms.
  • SQL, historian and reporting experience.
  • Telemetry and RTU experience.
  • Azure/AWS or cloud-connected industrial solutions.
  • IEC 62443 or wider OT cybersecurity experience.
  • Experience using secure remote-access solutions within controlled OT environments.

Interpersonal Skills

  • Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical matters clearly.
  • Ability to build effective working relationships with colleagues, clients and site personnel.
  • Organised and able to manage assigned tasks within a multitasking project environment.
  • Practical problem-solving ability and willingness to seek guidance where appropriate.
  • Ability to remain calm and focused under pressure.
  • Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary project teams.
  • Willingness to suggest improvements to safety, quality and delivery efficiency.
  • Awareness of project costs, programme and commercial considerations.

job.title: Tax Opportunities – Multiple Roles and Levels
job.description:
Tax Opportunities – Multiple Roles and Levels

Locations: Belfast, Dublin and Cork | Full-time | Hybrid working

About the Employer

Our client is a leading professional services firm with an established presence across Ireland and an extensive international network. The firm works with a diverse portfolio of clients, from entrepreneurial and privately owned businesses to multinational organisations and financial institutions.

With a strong focus on client relationships, technical excellence and collaboration, the firm provides a supportive environment where professionals can develop their expertise, take on new challenges and progress their careers.

Build Your Career

Are you looking for your next opportunity in tax or financial services?

Our client is expanding its tax teams across Belfast, Dublin and Cork and is seeking talented professionals at a range of levels, from executive and operational positions through to Assistant Manager, Manager, Associate Director and Director.

There are opportunities across several specialist areas, including Corporate Tax, International Tax, Corporate Tax and Transactions Advisory, Tax Incentives and R&D, Employer Solutions, UK VAT, Financial Services Tax and Payroll Administration.

Whether you are looking to deepen your technical expertise, step into a leadership role or explore a new specialism, these opportunities offer the chance to work with a varied client portfolio in a collaborative, professional environment.

Areas of Opportunity

  • Corporate Tax: Corporate tax compliance, reporting, planning and advisory services.

  • Corporate Tax and Transactions Advisory: Corporate tax advice, transaction-related matters and tax structuring.

  • International Tax: Cross-border tax advisory, international tax planning and support for multinational businesses.

  • Tax Incentives and R&D: Research and development tax credits and specialist tax reliefs.

  • Employer Solutions: Employment tax, employer compliance and related advisory services.

  • UK VAT: UK VAT compliance and advisory services.

  • Financial Services Tax: Tax compliance and advisory services for clients across the financial services sector.

  • Payroll Administration: Payroll processing, administration, record keeping and operational support.

The responsibilities and technical requirements will vary depending on the role, team and level of seniority.

What Will You Be Doing?

Depending on your area of expertise and level of experience, responsibilities may include:

  • Delivering high-quality tax compliance, reporting and advisory services to a varied client portfolio.

  • Advising on relevant tax legislation, regulatory requirements and tax planning opportunities.

  • Supporting corporate tax planning, international tax structuring, transaction advisory or specialist tax incentive projects.

  • Managing client engagements, coordinating deliverables and meeting deadlines.

  • Building strong relationships with clients and collaborating with colleagues across different service lines and international teams.

  • Conducting technical research and preparing reports, advice and client correspondence.

  • Identifying opportunities to improve client service and contribute to business development.

  • Supporting and mentoring junior colleagues where appropriate.

  • For senior appointments, leading teams, managing complex engagements, overseeing technical quality and contributing to the growth of the practice.

  • For payroll and operational positions, supporting accurate and timely processing, maintaining records and responding to relevant queries.

What Are We Looking For?

We welcome applications from professionals with relevant experience in tax, financial services, payroll or a related professional services environment.

Depending on the role, you may have:

  • Experience in Corporate Tax, International Tax, Financial Services Tax, Employer Solutions, VAT, Tax Incentives or another relevant specialism.

  • Knowledge of Irish tax legislation and compliance requirements for positions within the Irish tax practice, or relevant UK tax knowledge for UK VAT positions.

  • A professional qualification such as CTA, ACA, ACCA or ATT, where relevant to the position. CTA qualification is particularly relevant to many specialist tax roles.

  • Experience managing client relationships, delivering technical work and balancing competing priorities.

  • Strong analytical, communication, organisational and problem-solving skills.

  • A proactive approach, commercial awareness and a commitment to delivering high-quality work.

For management and leadership appointments, experience overseeing client engagements, developing people, maintaining technical standards and contributing to business development will be important.

For executive and payroll administration opportunities, requirements will reflect the specific responsibilities of the position.

You do not need experience across every tax specialism. The focus is on finding the right match between your skills, experience and career ambitions and the needs of the relevant team.

Locations and Working Arrangements

Opportunities are available in Belfast, Dublin and Cork, with the relevant location depending on the role.

The teams operate hybrid working arrangements, ideally involving approximately two to three days in the office per week, subject to client commitments and team requirements.

Career Development and Benefits

These opportunities offer the chance to develop technical expertise, work with experienced professionals, build lasting client relationships and progress within an established professional services environment.

The employer is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where collaboration, professional development and individual contributions are valued.

A competitive reward and benefits package is available, with further details provided during the recruitment process.

Interested in Finding Out More?

If you are an experienced tax professional or are looking to take the next step in your career, we would welcome your application.

Please indicate your preferred location, area of specialism and current level of experience so that your application can be considered for the most suitable opportunity.

Right to work: Candidates must meet the relevant right-to-work requirements for their chosen location. Visa sponsorship is not generally available. Eligibility for an Irish Critical Skills Employment Permit may be discussed where applicable.

Apply now to explore the opportunities available.

About you

  • Commercially minded, with a strong understanding of costing, margins and profitability.

job.title: Cath Lab Nurse
job.description:
Job Description

Job Title: CNM1 and Staff Nurse

Department: Cardiac Catheterisation Laboratory
Reports to: Nurse Manager / CNM2
Date: 2026

Overall Purpose of the Role

The organisation is committed to providing exceptional patient care within an environment where quality, respect, compassion and dignity are central to all aspects of care delivery.

The Clinical Coordinator is responsible for coordinating, directing and overseeing the day-to-day clinical and operational activities of the Cardiac Catheterisation Laboratory. The post holder will work collaboratively with the Cardiac Catheterisation Laboratory team and the wider Cardiology multidisciplinary team to ensure the delivery of safe, effective and high-quality patient care.

Key Responsibilities and Deliverables

The Clinical Coordinator will:

  • Coordinate and oversee the daily delivery of patient care within the unit.

  • Assess patient care requirements and analyse workload and staffing needs to ensure appropriate allocation of resources.

  • Assess staff competencies and allocate patient care responsibilities appropriately.

  • Delegate duties and responsibilities in accordance with legal and professional requirements, departmental policies and established standards.

  • Maintain effective communication with the Nurse Manager regarding operational requirements, patient care concerns, staffing issues and incidents.

  • Act as a clinical and professional resource for staff within the unit.

  • Provide direct patient care and clinical support when required.

  • Identify and maintain appropriate internal controls within the department and contribute to mechanisms that monitor compliance.

  • Ensure adherence to departmental policies, procedures, guidelines and internal controls.

  • Undertake other duties appropriate to the role as required.

Clinical Responsibilities

The post holder will:

  • Practise in accordance with the relevant professional standards and the Professional Scope of Practice Framework issued by the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Ireland (NMBI).

  • Maintain a high standard of clinical practice and professional conduct.

  • Promote safe, evidence-based and patient-centred care.

  • Ensure that patient care is delivered in accordance with organisational policies, procedures and clinical guidelines.

  • Support the delivery of high-quality care within the Cardiac Catheterisation Laboratory.

  • Escalate clinical concerns and patient safety issues appropriately and promptly.

Managerial Responsibilities

The post holder will:

  • Identify and communicate operational, clinical and staffing issues to the Nurse Manager in a timely manner.

  • Demonstrate knowledge and competence in relevant organisational policies, procedures and clinical guidelines.

  • Ensure that all required clinical and operational documentation is completed accurately and in a timely manner.

  • Respond appropriately to patient and service-user complaints and escalate concerns where necessary.

  • Monitor and contribute to risk management processes within the department.

  • Promote effective communication and collaboration across the multidisciplinary team.

  • Ensure the efficient and appropriate use of human, financial and other departmental resources.

  • Participate in unit and hospital-wide nursing communication processes.

  • Support the Nurse Manager in maintaining effective standards of service delivery.

Supervisory Responsibilities

The post holder will:

  • Allocate patient workloads appropriately, taking into consideration patient acuity, clinical requirements, staff competence and skill mix.

  • Provide direct and indirect supervision to Staff Nurses, Healthcare Assistants and unit reception staff as appropriate.

  • Monitor the delivery of patient care and provide guidance and support to staff.

  • Promote a safe, supportive and professional working environment.

  • Identify and escalate performance, competency or staffing concerns appropriately.

Interprofessional Relationships

The post holder will:

  • Develop and maintain effective working relationships with all relevant departments, medical staff, patients, families and external agencies.

  • Maintain effective communication with the Nurse Manager and Nurse Supervisor throughout the shift.

  • Demonstrate effective delegation of duties and responsibilities.

  • Participate in ongoing consultation and collaboration with physicians and other members of the multidisciplinary team to optimise patient outcomes and achieve unit-specific objectives.

  • Promote effective communication and teamwork within the clinical environment.

  • Demonstrate a willingness to support colleagues and assist with workload when required.

  • Promote a culture of respect, professionalism and collaborative practice.

Quality Improvement and Risk Management

The post holder will actively participate in quality management and continuous improvement processes, contributing to:

  • The identification and review of quality, policy and guideline issues.

  • The evaluation of current clinical practices against evidence-based and best-practice standards.

  • The development and implementation of appropriate clinical and operational standards using structure, process and outcome measures.

  • Hospital, regional and national audit processes.

  • Accreditation and quality-assurance processes.

  • Health promotion and patient education initiatives.

  • The identification and implementation of opportunities to improve patient safety, quality of care and service delivery.

  • The monitoring and review of clinical risks and implementation of appropriate risk-reduction measures.

  • Educational Responsibilities

Under the direction of the Nurse Manager, the post holder will:

  • Develop and utilise effective teaching and facilitation skills within the clinical environment.

  • Participate in the planning, implementation and evaluation of orientation and clinical teaching programmes for student nurses.

  • Provide appropriate feedback to Nurse Managers to support the completion of student nurse proficiency assessments.

  • Contribute to the identification of education and training needs within the clinical area.

  • Identify and contribute to the development of learning opportunities for staff within the department.

  • Participate in the clinical induction and orientation of newly appointed nursing and support staff.

  • Develop leadership skills and act as a positive and effective professional role model.

  • Support staff development through appropriate coaching, supervision and feedback.

  • Take responsibility for identifying and addressing personal learning and professional development needs.

Person Specification

Qualifications

Essential:

  • Current registration with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Ireland (NMBI) as a Registered General Nurse, with registration maintained in good standing.

  • Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification.

  • Current Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS) certification.

Desirable:

  • Relevant postgraduate qualification or specialist education in cardiology, cardiac nursing, cardiac catheterisation or a related area.

  • Where a relevant postgraduate qualification is not currently held, willingness to undertake an appropriate postgraduate programme within 18 months of commencing the Clinical Coordinator role.

Experience

The successful candidate will ideally have:

  • A minimum of two years' relevant clinical experience within a Cardiac Catheterisation Laboratory.

  • Demonstrable experience in clinical leadership and coordination.

  • Experience in teaching, mentoring and supporting nursing and healthcare staff.

  • Experience of working effectively within a multidisciplinary team.

  • Demonstrable professional judgement and the ability to make appropriate clinical decisions.

  • Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills.

  • The ability to prioritise and manage multiple tasks effectively within a busy clinical environment.

  • Effective time-management and organisational skills.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • A commitment to continuing professional development and lifelong learning.

  • The ability to communicate effectively in written and spoken English, with a high standard of grammar and professional communication.

To know more contact Sonal Tikariha
